g.text: BCK11 - Product Catalogue and Product Information
-evaluatePizza(product: Product, pizza: PredefinedPizza, facts: CatalogueFacts): CatalogueEntry
-evaluateSize(components: Product[], size: PizzaSize, facts: CatalogueFacts): PizzaSizeOffer | null
evaluate returns null only for a non-sellable Product; inactive sellable Products remain visible.
Product.pricingMode selects fixed base price or component-based pizza pricing.
COMPONENT_BASED without an associated PredefinedPizza => InvalidCatalogueData.
evaluatePizza derives allergens from resolved default components.
evaluateSize returns null for a structurally unsupported size.
Inactive Products/sizes are retained and marked unavailable.
Check each controlled component against CURRENT stock only.
Missing controlled stock / invalid persisted facts => InvalidCatalogueData.
This is a domain service, not a new Catalogue aggregate.
Application query port, not a replacement for owning-domain repositories.
Each call loads roots and their full dependency closure in one SQL statement.
Load all sellable Products regardless of active status, plus category/allergen records.
Load only CURRENT stock records; inactive sellable Products remain roots.
loadFor returns an empty roots array only for an absent or non-sellable id.
Raw SQL rows and pg types never cross this boundary.
(ProductId, PizzaSizeId) identifies at most one configuration.
Controlled component: integer consumption >= 0 is mandatory.
Price is BCK08 Money (EUR decimal string); no fallback price/consumption.
Sizes have string IDs, names and active status; no fixed S/M/L enum.
Include configured inactive sizes with available=false.
Missing component-size configuration still makes a size structurally unsupported.
getAvailableUnits() reuses the BCK09 read contract.
Use only records where getTrackingStatus() == CURRENT.
For pizzas compare availableUnits >= configured consumption per size.
For ordinary stock-controlled Products, zero current units means unavailable.
No stock increase/decrease is performed by catalogue consultation.
Product stores categoryId and allergenIds; CatalogueFacts resolves their names.
getName() returns ProductName; pizzaComponentTypeId is the actual field name.
isSellable() controls catalogue membership; isActive() affects availability only.
pricingMode is an existing BCK05 Product attribute; Money.sum is a proposed addition.
ProductId.create() throws the existing AppError (400) for invalid IDs.
Aggregate factories enforce owning-domain invariants on reconstitution.
only if approved access policy needs roles
All BCK11 components are proposed; no story implementation is provided.
Domain depends on no outer layer. DTOs are passive application data.
Configurable named PizzaSize follows the supplied domain model.
Component-size pairs identify at most one configuration.
Optional consumption follows the current global domain model.
Auth policy remains unresolved; no default anonymous/customer-only policy is asserted.
